method: tests/tools/facade-gen.php: every top-level, unconditional facade function whose body is one statement, with that statement; the PHP is rendered from this table (php tests/tools/facade-gen.php --write) and the style suite checks the two agree

_minn_attachment_js_fields.statement:
return [
        'id' => $attachment->ID,
        'title' => $attachment->post_title,
        'filename' => wp_basename((string) get_attached_file($attachment->ID)),
        'url' => $url,
        'link' => get_attachment_link($attachment->ID),
        'alt' => get_post_meta($attachment->ID, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', true),
        'author' => $attachment->post_author,
        'description' => $attachment->post_content,
        'caption' => $attachment->post_excerpt,
        'name' => $attachment->post_name,
        'status' => $attachment->post_status,
        'uploadedTo' => $attachment->post_parent,
        'date' => strtotime($attachment->post_date_gmt) * 1000,
        'modified' => strtotime($attachment->post_modified_gmt) * 1000,
        'menuOrder' => $attachment->menu_order,
        'mime' => $attachment->post_mime_type,
        'type' => $type,
        'subtype' => $subtype,
        'icon' => wp_mime_type_icon($attachment->ID),
        'dateFormatted' => mysql2date(get_option('date_format'), $attachment->post_date),
        'nonces' => ['update' => false, 'delete' => false, 'edit' => false],
        'editLink' => false,
        'meta' => false,
    ];

_minn_die_variable_mismatch.statement: wp_die(__('A variable mismatch has been detected.'), __('Sorry, you are not allowed to view this item.'), 400);

_minn_hierarchy_parent.statement: return static fn ($id) => isset($override[$id]) ? $override[$id] : call_user_func_array($callback, array_merge([$id], $callback_args));

_minn_register_toolbar_meta.statement:
register_meta('user', 'show_admin_bar_front', [
        'type' => 'string',
        'single' => true,
        'default' => 'true',
        'show_in_rest' => true,
        'sanitize_callback' => static fn ($value) => $value === 'false' ? 'false' : 'true',
        'auth_callback' => static fn ($allowed, $meta_key, $object_id) => current_user_can('edit_user', $object_id),
    ]);

_minn_term_query.statement: return new TermQuery(Runtime::current()->db, static fn (string $s): string => sanitize_title($s));

_wp_connectors_get_api_key_source.statement: return Connectors::keySource($setting_name, $env_var_name, $constant_name, static fn (string $name): mixed => get_option($name, ''));

add_filter.statement:
// A null priority (plugins pass one through) reads as the default.
    return Runtime::hooks()->add((string) $hook_name, $callback, $priority === null || $priority === '' ? 10 : $priority, (int) $accepted_args);

capital_P_dangit.statement:
// A title is set right everywhere; elsewhere only where the word plainly starts.
    return current_filter() === 'the_title' ? Minn\Content\TextFilters::capitalPEverywhere((string) $text) : Minn\Content\TextFilters::capitalP((string) $text);

excerpt_remove_footnotes.statement: return preg_replace('_\d+_', '', (string) $content);

filter_block_content.statement: return Kses::blockAttributes((string) $text, static fn (string $value): string => wp_kses($value, $allowed_html, (array) $allowed_protocols));

get_block_metadata_i18n_schema.statement: return (object) ['title' => 'block title', 'description' => 'block description', 'keywords' => ['block keyword'], 'styles' => [['label' => 'block style label']], 'variations' => [['title' => 'block variation title', 'description' => 'block variation description', 'keywords' => ['block variation keyword']]]];

get_default_block_categories.statement:
return [
        ['slug' => 'text', 'title' => _x('Text', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'media', 'title' => _x('Media', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'design', 'title' => _x('Design', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'widgets', 'title' => _x('Widgets', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'theme', 'title' => _x('Theme', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'embed', 'title' => _x('Embeds', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
        ['slug' => 'reusable', 'title' => _x('Patterns', 'block category'), 'icon' => null],
    ];

render_block_core_comments_pagination.statement: return trim((string) $content) === '' ? '' : '<nav ' . get_block_wrapper_attributes() . ' aria-label="' . esc_attr__('Comments pagination') . '">' . $content . '</nav>';

rest_output_rsd.statement: echo "\t" . '<api name="WP-API" blogID="1" preferred="false" apiLink="' . esc_url(get_rest_url()) . '" />' . "\n\t";

rsd_link.statement: echo '<link rel="EditURI" type="application/rsd+xml" title="RSD" href="' . esc_url(site_url('xmlrpc.php?rsd', 'rpc')) . '" />' . "\n";

sanitize_title_with_dashes.statement: return Slug::dashes((string) $title, $context === 'save', static fn (string $text, int $length) => utf8_uri_encode($text, $length));

utf8_uri_encode.statement: return Slug::uriEncode((string) $utf8_string, (int) $length, static fn (string $char): string => $encode_ascii_characters ? rawurlencode($char) : $char);

validate_plugin.statement: return is_file(WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . $plugin) ? 0 : new WP_Error('plugin_not_found', 'Plugin file does not exist.');

wp_autoload_values_to_autoload.statement:
// A filter may narrow the list, never widen it: what it returns is kept only where core knows the value, keys and all.
    return array_intersect(apply_filters('wp_autoload_values_to_autoload', Minn\Runtime\Options::AUTOLOAD_VALUES), Minn\Runtime\Options::AUTOLOAD_VALUES);

wp_cache_flush_runtime.statement:
// An external cache that brought no flush_runtime of its own cannot be asked to.
    return wp_using_ext_object_cache() ? false : Runtime::cache()->flush();

wp_connectors_get_application_password_c.statement: return Connectors::credentials($auth, static fn (string $name): mixed => get_option($name, ''), static fn (string $text): string => sanitize_text_field($text));

wp_connectors_sanitize_application_passw.statement: return Connectors::sanitizeCredentials($value, static fn (string $text): string => sanitize_text_field($text));

wp_create_initial_comment_meta.statement:
register_meta('comment', '_wp_note_status', [
        'type' => 'string',
        'description' => __('Note resolution status'),
        'single' => true,
        'show_in_rest' => ['schema' => ['type' => 'string', 'enum' => ['resolved', 'reopen']]],
        'auth_callback' => static fn ($allowed, $meta_key, $object_id) => current_user_can('edit_comment', $object_id),
    ]);

wp_get_computed_fluid_typography_value.statement: return Minn\Theme\Typography::clamp($args['minimum_viewport_width'] ?? null, $args['maximum_viewport_width'] ?? null, $args['minimum_font_size'] ?? null, $args['maximum_font_size'] ?? null, $args['scale_factor'] ?? null);

wp_get_widget_defaults.statement:
// One empty list per registered sidebar (probe widgets-remaining).
    return array_fill_keys(array_keys($GLOBALS['wp_registered_sidebars'] ?? []), []);

wp_is_home_url_using_https.statement: return wp_parse_url(apply_filters('home_url', get_option('home'), '', null, null), PHP_URL_SCHEME) === 'https';

wp_is_password_reset_allowed_for_user.statement: return $user instanceof WP_User ? apply_filters('allow_password_reset', true, $user->ID) : false;

wp_is_site_url_using_https.statement: return wp_parse_url(apply_filters('site_url', get_option('siteurl'), '', null, null), PHP_URL_SCHEME) === 'https';

wp_maybe_decline_date.statement:
// Declension applies to the Slavic locales only; en_US never changes.
    return apply_filters('wp_maybe_decline_date', (string) $date, (string) $format);

wp_pre_kses_block_attributes.statement: return Kses::blockAttributes((string) $content, static fn (string $value): string => wp_kses($value, $allowed_html, $allowed_protocols));

wp_pre_kses_less_than.statement: return Kses::lessThan((string) $content, static fn (string $text): string => esc_html($text));

wp_register_persisted_preferences_meta.statement:
register_meta('user', $GLOBALS['wpdb']->get_blog_prefix() . 'persisted_preferences', [
        'type' => 'object',
        'single' => true,
        'show_in_rest' => [
            'name' => 'persisted_preferences',
            'type' => 'object',
            'schema' => [
                'type' => 'object',
                'context' => ['edit'],
                'properties' => ['_modified' => ['description' => __('The date and time the preferences were updated.'), 'type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date-time', 'readonly' => false]],
                'additionalProperties' => true,
            ],
        ],
    ]);

wp_rel_ugc.statement: return \Minn\Content\TextFilters::rel((string) $text, 'nofollow ugc', static fn (string $href): bool => wp_is_internal_link($href));

wp_required_field_message.statement: return apply_filters('wp_required_field_message', '' . sprintf(__('Required fields are marked %s'), wp_required_field_indicator()) . '');

wp_robots_noindex.statement:
// A private site is kept out entirely: noindex, nofollow (probe robots-template).
    return (int) get_option('blog_public') === 0 ? wp_robots_no_robots($robots) : $robots;

wp_staticize_emoji.statement:
// WordPress's emoji images, served by the Minn update service (feeds and mail point readers here, never at wordpress.org).
    return Minn\Content\Emoji::staticize((string) $text, (string) apply_filters('emoji_url', Minn\Ops\Directory::url('assets/s/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/72x72/')), (string) apply_filters('emoji_ext', '.png'));

wp_timezone_choice.statement: return Minn\Support\TimezoneChoice::html((string) $selected_zone, static fn (string $text, string $domain): string => translate($text, $domain));

wp_using_themes.statement:
// True only where WP_USE_THEMES is (the engine sets it as index.php would), then the filter (probe load-remaining).
    return (bool) apply_filters('wp_using_themes', defined('WP_USE_THEMES') && WP_USE_THEMES);
